section.45: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

45.name_native: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

hadiths.text: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It does not seem proper for a Siddiq that he should be an invoker of curse
